lore.autowork.templater: Tries to put items by given template (in exactly same slots). Will not do anything if there's not enough items. Requires template card.
lore.autowork.sculk_cell: Stores experience. Right-click to deposit your experience and shift + right-click to take experience.
lore.autowork.controlled_catalyst: Collects and puts experience orbs when powered and has a Sculk Cell below.
lore.autowork.repair_station: Tries to repair tool with experience and resources when powered. Outputs repaired tool in front of itself.
lore.autowork.amethyst_bulb: Emits signal impulse on the back when redstone signal disappears on all the sides.
lore.autowork.quartz_bulb: Emits signal impulse on the back when redstone signal appears on at least one side.
lore.autowork.modular_carrier: Moves block in front of itself along when rotated. Also rotates other Modular Carriers above or below itself
lore.autowork.carrier: Moves block in front of itself along when powered and rotated.
lore.autowork.rotator: Rotates block in front of itself. Amount of rotation is configurable by right-clicking.
lore.autowork.redstone_coil: Emits concrete power of signal, configurable by right-clicking.
lore.autowork.redstone_hub: All outputs emit redstone signal when any of input side has redstone signal. Node's mode can be changed by right-clicking.
lore.autowork.holder: Holds item in itself. If item can contain fluid, energy or other items, it'll 'proxy' its capabilities through the block (works best with other mods; probably.)
lore.autowork.enricher: Enriches ore in front of itself when has fuel. Enriched ore drops a little bit more of resources than normal one.
lore.autowork.painter: Tries to dye the block in front of it using given dye.
lore.autowork.breeze_collector: When powered, sucks in all items in front of it and puts them in storage behind.
lore.autowork.buffer: Can hold 9 stacks. Right-click with item in your hand to put it in buffer or right-click without item to get last stack of buffer.
lore.autowork.buffered_breeze_collector: When powered, sucks in all items in front of it and puts them in internal storage.
lore.autowork.cartloader: Places a minecart when given minecart chests from the top, and an inventory from behind.
lore.autowork.cartrefiller: Puts items into already existing minecart with chest in front of it.
lore.autowork.buffered_cartrefiller: Puts items into already existing minecart with chest in front of it.
lore.autowork.buffered_cartloader: Places a minecart chest filled with items when powered.
lore.autowork.buffered_cartunloader: When minecart passes by, Cart Unloader will unload it: all its contents would be transferred to the internal storage.
lore.autowork.railway_observer: Detects minecart, can filter them by name if sign is placed.
lore.autowork.toggler: A copper bulb that emits signal from the back when it is lit.
lore.autowork.cartunloader: When minecart passes by and both storages are provided, Cart Unloader will unload it: all its contents would be transferred to the storage behind, and the minecart itself would appear in the storage above.
lore.autowork.chute: Transfers items downward into storage or air.
lore.autowork.distributor: Evenly distributes items between storages as a multiblock structure. Frankly, it's kinda confusing.
lore.autowork.drill: Destroys the block using given tool; all drops are collected in the internal storage.
lore.autowork.extractor: Transfers items from the storage in back to the storage in front.
lore.autowork.pump: When it has fuel and liquid below itself, it starts pumping the fluid upwards and tries to put it into fluid storage above. When finished, it emits a redstone signal.
lore.autowork.sculk_mover: Moves blocks in front of itself closer when powered with redstone, including some that are not movable by pistons.
lore.autowork.fluid_extractor: Replaces block in front of itself with fluid behind. If there is a storage in front of it, it'll put the fluid in it. If there is a storage behind AND in front of it, it'll transfer 1000mb of fluid.
lore.autowork.smelter: Tries to convert one block into another using lava.
lore.autowork.spiller: Places fluid from storage in front of itself if there is space. If not, it'll try to convert block in front of itself using fluid.
lore.autowork.precise_observer: Configurable observer; will emit signal only when a specific block is in front of it.
lore.autowork.fluid_barrel: Fluids can be inserted/extracted manually when opened. Holds a capacity of 5000mb.
lore.autowork.fan: Just a fan. Right-click to change wind direction.
lore.autowork.filter_chute: A chute but with filter. Right-click with item to change filter, crouch + RMB to toggle blacklist.
lore.autowork.placer: Places blocks from its storage in front of itself.
lore.autowork.ticker: Rename clock to format: XmYsZt and then right-click the Ticker with it to set its timer.
lore.autowork.transmitter: Transfers redstone signal by air. Powered from behind, sends and recieves from the front.
lore.autowork.andgate: Emits signal only when both sides are powered.
